name: Fallen Sky Lake
summary: In eastern Ashenvale, Fallen Sky Lake lies between Silverwing Outpost and the Warsong Labor Camp. Shadethickets defend its shores and central isle.

sections.title: A Contested Sanctuary
sections.body: Fallen Sky Lake lies south of Silverwing Outpost and west of the Warsong Labor Camp. Shadethickets, hulking bog beasts, roam its shores and the small isle at its center, treating intruders as threats. A powerful Shadethicket Oracle rules from the isle's heart. The Oracle hoards the fallen moonstones once gathered at the lake and keeps the shadethickets bound to the waters, ever watchful for travelers.

faq.q: Where is Fallen Sky Lake located?
aliases: how to find fallen sky lake
faq.answer: Fallen Sky Lake lies in eastern Ashenvale, south of Silverwing Outpost, west of the Warsong Labor Camp, and northeast of Silverwing Grove.

faq.q: What creatures live around Fallen Sky Lake?
aliases: what is at fallen sky lake
faq.answer: Shadethickets, aggressive bog beasts, roam the lake and its banks. A Shadethicket Oracle leads them from the central isle.

faq.q: Why is the Shadethicket Oracle important?
faq.answer: The Shadethicket Oracle leads the shadethickets at the lake and hoards the fallen moonstones night elves once gathered there. Anyone who needs a moonstone must slay the Oracle on the central isle.

angles.text: As a druid, you know night elves once gathered moonstones at Fallen Sky Lake. Shadethicket bog beasts now claim its waters and make this quiet forest corner dangerous.
As a night elf, you find Fallen Sky Lake just south of Silverwing Outpost, in your sacred ancestral forest. Wild beasts have grown erratic amid the Horde's gathering drums.
